description.p: Mouth your words, then paste them at the cursor. Lipflow reads lips on your computer, with optional audio for whisper mode.
Practice sentences, train on your face, add custom words, and revisit your dictation history. GNOME asks for camera, shortcut, background, and keyboard permission.
The speech recognition weights download separately and are restricted to research use. Optional Claude cleanup sends candidate text to Anthropic; offline cleanup is available.
